g.text: Catalog 3 of 3 · Like and low-stock notification
A manager can't like a product:
this isn't a bookmark, it's a subscription
any write that leaves the variant
[The variant drops to the low-stock threshold]
Whoever already bought it doesn't need the notice
Sends the notice with the specific variant
Three attempts with backoff and then the failed queue.
Losing a stock notice is recoverable; that's why
this queue doesn't have the payment-settlement policy.
